explanation: Three of the four once were. The US Open left grass after 1974 and the Australian Open after 1987, and both later settled on hard courts.

claims.text: Wimbledon is the Grand Slam tennis tournament played on grass courts.
The US Open, Australian Open and French Open are not played on grass.
The US Open was played on grass until 1974 and the Australian Open until 1987.
The US Open moved to hard courts in 1978 after three years on clay, and the Australian Open moved to hard courts in 1988.
